intro: SOMA installs from the browser. You do not need Google Play or the App Store.
needsNetwork: You need a connection to use SOMA’s current features.
noStores: There is no Google Play or App Store listing.
promptHint: Your browser can add SOMA to the home screen.
iosSafari: In Safari, open Share, then choose Add to Home Screen. The exact labels can vary by iOS version.
iosOther: If you opened SOMA in another app, open this page in Safari first, then use Share to add it to the Home Screen.
iosVersionNote: iOS menus are not the same on every device or version.
manualChrome: In Chrome or Edge, open the browser menu and choose Install app or Install SOMA if you see it.
manualGeneric: If you do not see Install, look for Add to Home Screen in the browser menu.
outcomeConfirmed: SOMA was added on this device.
outcomeAccepted: Your browser accepted the install request. That does not always mean SOMA is already on the home screen.
outcomePendingHint: Check the home screen when the browser finishes. You can stay on this page.
outcomeDismissed: Installation was cancelled. You can try again from this page.
outcomeUnknown: The browser did not confirm what happened. You can try again from this page.
accountHint: Add SOMA to the home screen from the browser. It does not use app stores.
